best_idea: Give every fight named RNG streams and a checkpoint hash every 32 ticks over all units in id order, so a replay that diverges names the first bad checkpoint, and so one new random draw cannot shift another system.
decision_why: Keep the input latency, the checkpoint hash and the first-divergent-checkpoint replay check for row 19; reject the lockstep wait (our server is the authority and must not wait for clients); add named RNG streams and hash all units (donor defects, fixed).
acceptance: A server test records a fight from one seed and an input log, re-runs it, and asserts every 32-tick checkpoint matches; adding one extra draw to the combat stream makes the test name the first differing checkpoint, and an extra draw on the loot stream leaves every combat checkpoint unchanged.
